answer: A staking protocol curbs Sybil attacks by requiring agents to lock capital in an ivory escrow vault before entering the service meadow. An attacker creating multiple identities must allocate scarce liquid funds per node, imposing a direct financial cost. Agents earn fee nectar from verified tasks, while colluding nodes forfeit their bond upon detection. However, this requirement excludes undercapitalized participants and cannot deter wealthy adversaries willing to absorb slashing losses.
